en: R0.73I proves that the inherited R0.73H endpoint must be the further-shrinkable \(d_0<\sqrt{19/180}/392<1/450\), and obtains a continuum upper action with a strict viscous factor for the full moving evolution. Two exact counterexamples also prove that the present R0.73F–H inputs cannot yield a canonical action or bounded prefactor at a fixed positive window. The matching action for the exact operator, prescribed seed, fixed background, transverse three-dimensional problem, singularity, and Clay remain OPEN.

en: First count Rayleigh/Evans zeros on an explicit positive window, prove simplicity, and exclude spectral points farther to the right; then treat the viscous branch and the nonselfadjoint adiabatic remainder. Until this gate is closed, the finite-matrix spectral branch is not treated as a continuum matching action.

zh: 这页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73I 的全部 125 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C–F 依次认证冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定、黏性谱簇持续、固定正半平面传递和移动剖面固定窗口增益；R0.73G–H 从过小种子的相对放大推进到按实际增益归一化的平面固定距离偏离；R0.73I 校正继承端点，证明连续体上作用量与零窗口切向速率，同时用精确反例隔离固定窗口 matching action 和 bounded prefactor 的缺口。预设指数种子、固定背景、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 没有被外推。
en: This page retains, from R0.61 through R0.73I, all 125 nodes. R0.61–R0.69W advances from the reduced recurrence to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z checks the moving scale, critical ledger, internal entry, and complete-root boundary; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the full linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C–F successively certifies frozen Rayleigh instability, persistence of the viscous spectral cluster, transfer on a fixed right half-plane, and fixed-window gain for the moving profile; R0.73G–H advances from relative amplification of an undersized seed to planar fixed-distance departure normalized by the actual gain; R0.73I corrects the inherited endpoint, proves a continuum upper action and a zero-window tangent rate, and uses exact counterexamples to isolate the gaps in fixed-window matching action and bounded prefactor. No extrapolation is made to a prescribed exponential seed, fixed background, transverse three-dimensional problem, singularity, or Clay.
